country.title: Country
country.description: Country of the Budget Lines, e.g. Kenya. The authoritative filter.

dimensionName.title: Dimension Name
dimensionName.description: Optional: the dimension the value belongs to — Department, Cost Category, Cost Type, Sub-Unit, or Business Unit. Pass when the user is explicit (e.g. 'Cost Category = Crop Insurance'); leave blank to auto-detect (the action asks if the value is ambiguous across dimensions).

dimensionValue.title: Dimension Value
dimensionValue.description: DIMENSION MODE: an explicit lower-level Budget Line value the user named that is NOT a standard program, e.g. Crop Insurance, Staff Costs, Field Operations. Pass ONLY when the user asks about grants funding a specific dimension/item. Combine with program to segment a standard program.

extraDimensionName.title: Extra Dimension Name
extraDimensionName.description: Optional dimension name for the second value (Department / Cost Category / Cost Type / Sub-Unit / Business Unit).

extraDimensionValue.title: Extra Dimension Value
extraDimensionValue.description: Optional second explicit dimension value, for combined filters.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2027. Defaults to the current scenario when omitted.

program.title: Program
program.description: PROGRAM MODE: the standard Headroom category the user named (Core Program, Rural Retail, Market Access, Trees, System Change Extension). Pass the user's wording; the action resolves synonyms. LEAVE BLANK for a pure dimension query (e.g. grants funding Crop Insurance). Combine with a dimension value to segment a standard program.
